title: Grateful Dead Live at Augusta Civic Center on 1984-10-12
source: lineage: (3)audio technica atm11fob> optimus> d-5> mc> sony tc we435> sony pcm m-10 24bit/96khz> soundforge> cdwave> traders little helper encoding option 8; conversion rate: 96000/24 bit

ai_review.summary: Warm, rich‑sounding 24‑bit recording captures an intimate, high‑energy show with a fantastic set list and flawless Jerry Garcia vocals.
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves that the performance is one of the best ever heard – rich, warm tones in an intimate setting, great crowd energy and a superb set list. The 24‑bit FLAC source sounds crystal clear and balanced, earning a perfect five‑star rating for both the music and the recording.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic review gives 5 stars for both performance and recording, indicating an exceptional show and excellent audio quality; limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes rich, warm tones and praises the 24‑bit FLAC fidelity; no issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Intimate atmosphere with a fantastic set list; crowd response described as great.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice was fine and highlighted positively.
